summary: Astrotech Corp filed a prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 terminating its at-the-market offering under the June 2026 prospectus and transitioning to a new $50 million ATM facility under an August 2026 supplement. The registrant, acting as issuer, reported prior sales of 258,856 shares for gross proceeds of approximately $7.9 million under the prior agreement with H.C. Wainwright. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine capital-raising administrative update with no board action, advisors, or deal terms.
